crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: Small, red, semi-circular patch visible at the posterior crown/upper nape.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Sharp, high-contrast linear boundary separating the red crown region from the uniform grey mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent black and white horizontal barring across the entire visible surface of the tail feathers.
